response.cover_letter:
January 22, 2026

Ms. Barbara Grinder
Contract Specialist
Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division
4219 South Patterson Road
Indian Head, MD 20640

RE: RFQ N0017426Q1009 - Secured Web Fingerprint Transmission (SWFT) Fingerprint Services Quote

Dear Ms. Grinder,

Dee Davis Inc. acknowledges receipt of RFQ N0017426Q1009 for Secured Web Fingerprint Transmission (SWFT) Fingerprint Services and is pleased to submit our quote for the Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division's fingerprint collection requirements.

As an EDWOSB/WOSB certified small business (CAGE: 8UMX3, UEI: HJB4KNYJVGZ1) with active SAM.gov registration, Dee Davis Inc. specializes in contract management and procurement services through our network of vetted subcontractor partnerships. We understand NSWC IHD's need for reliable SWFT fingerprint collection services supporting up to 900 personnel annually across nationwide locations.

Our approach leverages established partnerships with DCSA-certified SWFT providers who maintain Live Scan equipment at strategic locations throughout the United States. This network ensures compliance with OPM standards, maintains rejection rates below the required 2% threshold, and provides the web-based scheduling and tracking capabilities specified in your requirements.

We are fully committed to supporting your personnel background investigation requirements throughout the base year and all four option years. Our team is prepared to begin performance on February 25, 2026, and maintain the quality standards essential to NSWC IHD's mission.

Thank you for this opportunity to serve the Department of the Navy. Please contact me directly at 248.376.4550 or dee@deedavis.biz with any questions regarding our quote.

Respectfully submitted,

Dee Davis
Chief Executive Officer
Dee Davis Inc.
